description: This file contains unit tests for the GlobalPrefsBackup functionality in the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing backup and restore operations of preferences, including custom paths and provider handling.

classes.name: GlobalPrefsBackupTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the backup and restore functionality of global preferences in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: assertRootsEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two PrefsRoot objects are equal by comparing their versions and child items.

methods.name: assertPrefItemsEqual
methods.description: Recursively asserts that two PrefItem objects are equal in their values and children.

methods.name: testBackupRestoreCustomPath
methods.description: Tests the backup and restore process using a custom file path.

methods.name: testGetAllPrefsProviders
methods.description: Verifies that all preference providers are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testBackupRestoreHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the standard backup and restore process for a single provider.

methods.name: testOnlyBackupRestoreEnabledProviders
methods.description: Tests backup and restore behavior when some providers are disabled.
